android.desc: Make your Android home screen faster, cleaner, and truly yours. Smart Launcher automatically organizes your apps, adapts its colors to your wallpaper, and keeps everything you use most within easy reach. 🏅 Trusted by more than 50 million users worldwide. ----- WHY YOU'LL LOVE SMART LAUNCHER • Your apps, automatically organized Smart Launcher sorts your apps into categories, keeping your phone tidy and making everything easier to find. • A home screen that matches your style Colors automatically adapt to your wallpaper. You can also customize every part of your theme, choose from thousands of Google Fonts, and use your favorite icon packs. • Designed for one-handed use The apps and actions you use most are placed near the bottom of the screen, where they are easier to reach. • Powerful widgets, built in Use responsive widgets for weather, photos, calendar, battery, music, notes, and more. Widget stacks let you place multiple widgets in the same space and scroll between them. • Fast and flexible search Find apps and contacts instantly, search the web, run calculations, or start common actions directly from the search bar. • Make your home screen personal Create custom stickers, place them among your icons and widgets, and build a layout that feels completely your own. • News directly on your home screen Follow your favorite sources using the customizable built-in news reader with RSS support. ----- MORE CONTROL WHEN YOU NEED IT • Configure gestures and hotkeys for actions such as turning off the screen or opening notifications. • See which apps have active notifications without installing an additional plugin. • Hide private apps and protect them with a PIN. • Use adaptive icons for a more consistent visual style. • Hide system bars for a more immersive home screen. • Browse wallpapers from different sources and back up your current wallpaper before changing it. ----- Smart Launcher is regularly updated to support new Android versions, devices, and community requests.
